options.name: avd_catalogs
options.description: AVD-generated test catalogs settings. These settings are used to generate test catalogs based on the AVD structured configurations.

options.name: device_list
options.description: List of devices to run ANTA tests against. These devices must be defined in the Ansible inventory.

options.name: report
options.description: ANTA report settings. These settings define the output format and location of the ANTA reports.

options.name: runner
options.description: ANTA runner settings. These settings change the behavior of the ANTA runner.

options.name: user_catalogs
options.description: User-defined test catalogs settings. These settings are used to run user-provided ANTA catalogs against the devices.
